activities.title: Etai's Bakery Cafe
activities.description:
Location: Concourse B

Find a variety of fresh bread, pastries, sandwiches, soups, and more. A highly reliable spot for a high-quality sit-down meal or a fresh grab-and-go bite.

activities.title: Steve's Snappin' Dogs
activities.description:
Location: Concourse B, near Gate B24

Features award-winning, gourmet hot dogs direct from New Jersey. They also offer a full bar with an excellent selection of local Colorado craft beers on tap.

activities.title: Modern Market Eatery
activities.description:
Location: Concourse C, near Gate C28

Offers freshly-made, healthy sandwiches, salads, and pizzas (including a great breakfast menu). Craft beer and wine are also available alongside fresh juices.
